label: Diagram 4.2
caption: Diagram 4.2 Layout restrictions on class D-s3, d2 plastic rooflights, TP(b) rooflights and TP(b) lighting diffusers
description:
This drawing is a plan showing the layout restrictions on class D-s3, d2 plastic rooflights, TP(b) rooflights and TP(b) lighting diffusers. In the top left corner, "See Table 4.2" is printed. On the left, a dashed square boundary encloses six solid-outlined rectangles arranged in three rows and two columns, and below it a smaller dashed rectangle boundary encloses two solid-outlined rectangles side by side. On the right, a dashed square contains a long solid-outlined rectangle at the top and a solid-outlined square at the bottom left, with text to the right of the square.

Dimensions and labels indicate the boundaries are a "5m maximum dimension of group". At the top, between the left and right sections, a horizontal distance of "3m min." is marked, and on the left a vertical distance of "3m min." is marked between the upper and lower left boundaries. A "5m max." dimension is shown vertically on the right. Text on the right states, "5m² is maximum area of diffuser and rooflight in any one 5m×5m group".

A legend on the bottom right identifies the solid-outlined shapes as "Rooflight or diffuser" and the dashed boundary as "Separated groups of rooflights or diffusers". Below the plan, notes state: "1. Upper and lower surfaces of suspended ceiling, between plastic panels, to comply with paragraph 4.1.", "2. No restriction on class D-s3, d2 diffusers or rooflights in small rooms.", and "3. See note 4 to Table 4.2."
